subject: Discovery recap + pilot charter / onboarding requests (Galeon)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Sutter <tom.sutter@galeon.com>, Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@galeon.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed pilot charter (Galeon)

Hi Tom / Anna — great to meet yesterday. Quick recap while items are fresh and a proposed minimal pilot charter so we can lock dates. High level notes from our call: 

Pain points you described:
- High false-positive rate from current intent classifier (esp. forms/returns) causing manual triage backlog.
- Latency spikes during morning batch windows impacting UX for power users.
- Data residency / audit requirements for customer PII.

Galeon goal for a successful 30-day pilot:
- Reduce manual triage by 30% on target flows.
- Median inference latency <= 120ms at target QPS for the 99th percentile.
- Evidence pack (logs & prompts) for your security review.

Proposed pilot scope (attached: galeon_mvp_scope.xlsx):
1) Two production-like endpoints for intent classification + reranking (Redwood hosted sandbox).
2) Prompt/eval set: 250 labeled examples + 1 unlabeled stream for quality monitoring.
3) Success metrics: triage reduction %, latency P99, false-positive delta on labeled set.
4) Access & owners: Galeon engineering lead to provide sample data + one AWS role for S3 access; Redwood will provide a short telemetry dashboard.
5) Timeline: prep week (Mar 1–7), deployment + baseline tests (Mar 8–14), 30-day run Mar 15–Apr 14, final readout Apr 19.

Immediate asks from our side to get started:
- Provide a sandbox S3 path (read-only) with ~2k anonymized examples or a secure transfer link.
- Point person for infra access (name, email, and role).
- SOC 2 attestation request (we can share our redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).

Notes on feature tradeoffs we discussed: we can run an optimized quantized model for lower cost but will need to validate small quality drift against your labeled set; we recommend enabling prefix caching for frequent flows.

Next steps (action items):
- Tom: confirm owners + share S3 role/credentials (by Tue 2/23).
- Galeon security: confirm SOC2 / evidence channel suitable (procurement@?)
- Kimberly: send SOW template + proposed kickoff week and a short onboarding checklist (attached).

I attached a draft scope workbook (galeon_mvp_scope.xlsx) and our SOW template (sow_template_redwood.docx). I’m happy to jump back on a quick 20-min call to walk the scope if helpful.

Thanks — K

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0113
From: Tom Sutter <tom.sutter@galeon.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@galeon.com>
Cc: procurement@galeon.com
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed pilot charter (Galeon)

Thanks Kimberly — useful summary. A few clarifications from our side after chatting with Anna and the infra team: 

1) Data residency: we need to confirm the hosted sandbox will not replicate PII to non-US regions. Is the sandbox tied to a US region and can you provide the data flow diagram?
2) Security artifacts: procurement asked if you can share a short SOC2 summary and retention policy; please send the redwood-soc2-summary.pdf and any short answers.
3) On-prem connector: there's a real chance we’ll need a private connector for the production rollout. For the pilot we can use the hosted sandbox but can you confirm whether the connector is a separate engineering effort and an estimated lead time?

Procurement also flagged that they’ll want a ballpark estimate of cost for a 30-day pilot + run-rate for production. If you can share a pricing sketch that would be helpful for internal signoff.

We can confirm owners by tomorrow. Anna will be our engineering lead (anna.lopez@galeon.com) and she can provide the S3 role.

—Tom

Hi all — Ben from Solutions Engineering here. Quick answers to the technical clarifications and a suggested operational owner matrix.

On residency and sandbox: we can host the sandbox in a US-only region and will confirm no cross-region replication. I’ve attached a short architecture sketch in the drive link (see related_links). For the SOC2 questions, Kimberly will attach the summary; for anything more detailed we can set up a control-mapping session with our security team next week.

On the on-prem connector: yes — that’s a separate engineering project. Typical lead time for our connector kit (VPC + private control plane) is 4–6 weeks to integrate, shorter if Galeon’s infra team can take the connector as a library and host it. For the pilot we recommend the hosted sandbox route to get to signal faster.

Operational owners (suggested):
- Galeon: Anna Lopez (engineering lead) — infra & S3 provisioning
- Galeon: Security liaison — procurement@galeon.com (to coordinate evidence)
- Redwood: Kimberly Park — program lead & readout owner
- Redwood: Ben Carter — systems onboarding / model tuning
- Redwood: Priyom Das — prompt engineering & evals

Pricing sketch: a conservative pilot estimate is attached in the SOW template (sow_template_redwood.docx) — base hosted sandbox + 3 reserved GPU-days for tuning. If procurement needs a line-item sheet I can extract numbers and send by EOD Tue.

Action items from Redwood:
- We will produce the initial prompt/eval set template and a short telemetry dashboard (Priyom).
- Share SOC2 summary and retention answers (Kimberly).
- Ready a brief pricing line-item for procurement (Ben).

—Ben
